title: search_urls records a PyPI 404 as no answer, asks PyPI with a space-joined query, and drops a PyPI hit as a hub page
goal: factdiff.search_urls reads a PyPI search as provider.search does: it joins the query with the provider's joiner (provider.search_shape's second value, '-' for PyPI), reads a PyPI 404 as an answer with no hits rather than an unanswered search, and keeps a PyPI project hit whose package_url ends in '/' instead of dropping it as a hub page

run:
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import factdiff as f, provider as p
row = {"search_api": "https://pypi.org/pypi/{q}/json"}
urls = []
def not_found(u, **k):
    urls.append(u)
    return {"status": 404, "body": b"", "headers": {}}
p.gated_request = not_found
f.search_urls("presidio analyzer returns entities", None, row, "https://pypi.org/project/presidio-analyzer/")
unanswered = [r for r in f._unanswered if "pypi.org" in r]
f._searches.clear()
f._unanswered.clear()
def found(u, **k):
    urls.append(u)
    return {"status": 200, "body": json.dumps({"info": {"name": "requests", "package_url": "https://pypi.org/project/requests/"}, "releases": {}}), "headers": {}}
p.gated_request = found
hits = f.search_urls("requests sends http", None, row, "https://pypi.org/project/old/")
joined = any("requests-sends-http" in u for u in urls)
print("unanswered:", unanswered, "hits:", hits, "joined with the provider's joiner:", joined)
sys.exit(0 if not unanswered and hits and joined else 1)
